historyPolicy.earlierCalls: Use the earliest verified pre-change rates as an unbounded baseline.
historyPolicy.dateOnly: An official effective date without a time is represented at 00:00 UTC and explicitly labelled; it is not an official timestamp.
historyPolicy.publicationDate: Where an already-active price is first announced without a separate start, use its labelled official publication date at 00:00 UTC; do not claim an exact activation time.

historyReview.scope: Existing exact offline price keys; standard direct-provider USD token rates. This review does not assert that all historical prices are publicly recoverable.
historyReview.baselineMeaning: A retained undated baseline is an existing estimate, not evidence that this model never changed price. Missing official dates or pre-change rates are not invented.

remainingEvidenceLimits.reason: Snapshot release dates alone do not prove exact rolling-alias billing cutovers. Keep the existing baseline until official old/new rates and alias cutovers can be reconciled.
Model-generation updates have different prices. Complete old alias cutover/rate evidence is unavailable; current pinned SKUs are not backdated as alias history.

Some official changes depend on three/four context tiers, deployment region, cache type or thinking mode. Source fields and the current two-tier USD estimator cannot uniquely represent all those dimensions; do not insert a guessed flat price.
